div.div:
by construction
enters the head detached: the argmax is piecewise constant in the bounds, so the head reads it as a fixed feature of the current solve and no gradient flows through it
the growth column keeps its gated affine and , so the cell is the round-18 gated cell at initialization
the head's weight norm is logged each epoch (ess_flux_head_w_norm); , the ceilings and the pool hold exactly at as in round 18

div.div:
measured (rounds 11 and 18)
round 11 measured the deletion's pFBA flux vector at 0.77 as an encoding against its growth ratio at 0.65, and the dual-overlap probe measured that the ceilings bind on the same six reactions for every genotype; this reads what the solve returns instead of what it can move
